text:
maria: Kicking off a config-only deploy now — routing/batching/limits tweak. Canary 5% for 20m. Excluding known noisy tenant by default. Deploy bot + observability on watch.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: Starting deploy config-only/2025-03-04T18:00Z -> canary 5% (targets: model-embed routing weight 0.9->0.7, batching window 40ms->60ms, tenant_default_concurrency 8->12). Auto-promote if health checks pass.

sam: tagging dashboards and alerting — I'll watch p50/p95/p99 + 502/5xx counts.

jamie: FYI removing tenant-x (known kv pressure) from canary list per offline convo. PR #4321 has exclusion list.

maria: Applying exclusion now. Pushing a short override so tenant-x stays on baseline config.

maria: config snippet:
```json
{
  "routing": {"model-embed": {"weight": 0.7}},
  "batching": {"window_ms": 60, "max_batch_tokens": 2048},
  "limits": {"tenant_default_concurrency": 12},
  "canary": {"percent": 5, "duration_min": 20, "exclude_tenants": ["tenant-x"]}
}
```

ops-bot: Applied canary config to hosts: infra-node-12, infra-node-17, infra-node-19.

sam: Quick check: p95 latency +3ms, no error spike yet. dashboard: https://obs.redwood/boards/abc123

maria: Good. Plan: wait 15m then promote to 25% if stable.

taylor: Noted. I'll watch regions and the model-embed shard.

sam: 8m into canary — seeing a small 502 cluster for tenant-y (2 tenants affected). Investigating logs now.

taylor: Pinging @sam — looks like those tenants have very long conversation histories. Could be kv-cache pressure.

sam: Logs show repeated "kv-cache pressure exceeded" and spike in request latency for model-embed on tenant-y. Suggest pinning tenant-y to previous config while we investigate.

maria: Agreed. Creating per-tenant override to pin tenant-y to previous limits (concurrency 8, batching.window 40).

jamie: Pushing override now -> `override/tenant-y` applied.

deploy-bot: Override applied: tenant-y -> pinned to config v2025-03-04-prev (tenant_default_concurrency=8, batching.window_ms=40).

sam: After pin, 502s dropped back to baseline within 90s. Latency also back down.

maria: Nice. We'll continue rollout excluding tenant-x and with tenant-y pinned. Promoting canary to 25% now.

deploy-bot: Promoting canary to 25% (monitor duration 25m).

taylor: Monitoring across regions — no new errors in first 10m of 25% window.

sam: 10m in at 25%: metrics stable, no SLO breaches.

maria: Updating release notes: 
- Config-only: model-embed routing weight reduced (0.9->0.7) to rebalance latency/cost.
- Batching window increased (40ms->60ms) and max_batch_tokens=2048.
- Default tenant concurrency increased (8->12) to improve throughput for small tenants.
- Excluded tenant-x from canary; tenant-y pinned to previous config due to kv-cache pressure.
Follow-up: INF-987 to add adaptive per-tenant kv heuristics.

maria: Release doc updated: https://docs.redwood/releases/2025-03-04-config-only

ops-bot: Canary 25% healthy. Auto-promote to 100% in 30m if no regressions.

sam: Quick action item: add a short-term circuit that reduces tenant_default_concurrency when kv pressure detected (to avoid future emergency pins).

maria: +1. Created INF-988 for runtime work and assigned to eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: final promotion to 100% at 1751112950. Note: tenant-y remains pinned to previous config via override; tenant-x excluded.

maria: Closing the rollout thread. Thanks all — will follow up on INF tickets. :checkered_flag:
